items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Eli Wilinsky, the Jewish kid who worked with you. ... He was very fine, and I enjoyed time with him

ctx.x: Well, the one characteristic thing about you Ernie is that all the guys that ever worked with you always venerated you, they loved you. I never heard a guy speak bad of you, and I mean this sincerely. I know hundreds of guys, and Ernie, they loved you, so you must have been fair, you must have been honest, which all bandleaders are not, not all

bandleaders are liked. I can name you some that are hated and guys don't even like to mention the fact that they worked with them, but every one that ever worked with you, Ernie--Eli Wilinsky, the Jewish kid who worked with you.

He was very fine, and I enjoyed time with him, and the funniest thing about it, I think I told you when he first began, I had a white musician in twenty eight, and some say that Benny Goodman was the first to have a mixed band, but I had a mixed band in twenty eight--
